claim: Two historical routes. (1) The custom-battle historical screens (sp_battle2_scenario, main_panel Initialise("historic", prefs, <all>), SetupBattle -> sp_battle3_scenario StartBattle): FrontEnd.EnumerateBattleMaps("historic", false) returns 0 maps because the single-player historical battles are not in that list at all (CAUSE, J46): they come from FrontEnd.EnumerateNapoleonsBattleMaps() (12 NHB_ battles, same list with true or false), shown by the main menu's Napoleon's Battles page (napoleon_battles; map_panel has one icon per Key). ("historic", true) returns 15 multiplayer NHMPB_ setups; presets with all_maps=1 load NHMPB_Dresden_3v3 (terrain hb_dresden) and NHMPB_Nile_1v1 (hb_nile). (2) Napoleon's Battles (preset type=napoleon, J46): the icon's state is the profile's unlock state: on this PC only NHB_Lodi is unlocked (unlocked_land), NHB_Friedland and NHB_Waterloo_Well are locked_land_dlc, the other nine are inactive (locked until earlier battles are won); autostart calls the page's SelectMap(icon address) then movie_panel:SetupBattle() (UIHistoricBattleSetup -> FrontEnd.StartBattle) and refuses a locked icon. So hist_lodi loads (terrain hb_lodi) and Austerlitz and Trafalgar single-player cannot be started until the profile unlocks them (not written by the harness: profile and saves are Liam's). A historical setup File ends in an .xml whose terrain folder differs: the preset names terrain=. A warm reset out of a historical battle stopped after closing mp_postbattle in J44 (leave by a relaunch, which ctl.py scene does); J46 saw a warm reset to the front end from hist_lodi answer ok
